svg.title: ASAR local surface-width reports, August2007–July2010 mean
svg.desc: Three separately scoped reports: NwASC at P1,60km FWHM; NwASC at S1,36km conditional on an isobath partition; NCC near64N,30km with unspecified width boundary rule. Mixed45km P2 and60km S1 profiles are excluded from separate-current widths. No annual envelope or width error is supplied.

g.text: Local surface widths from an ASAR mean field
August2007–July2010 · source reports · different local operators
Excluded mixed profiles: P2,45km; S1,60km (NwASC + NCC).
Widths of a mean field. No seasonal range, physical edges or width error.
Bars share8px/km; colors separate operators, not confidence levels.
